original_description: Create and revise short explainer videos and slides in your Fablyn workspace. Describe what you want to explain, then use Fablyn to save a Video, check its stills, and refine the words, layout and motion. Add optional narration and render a finished video, or approve stills as slides. Review your work and manage approvals in Fablyn Studio. A Fablyn account is required. Narration and rendering use your workspace’s minutes.
summary_ja: 短い説明動画やスライドを作成・修正し、Fablynで確認する。
limitations: Fablynアカウントが必要。ナレーションとレンダリングはワークスペースの時間枠を消費。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
